description: Risk Analysis of Healthcare Network in the San Francisco Bay is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Luis Ceferino, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This folder was prepared by L. Ceferino (ceferino@berkeley.edu) and contains data and code to reproduce the results of Ceferino et al. (2025). "Accessing Acute Care Hospitals in the San Francisco Bay after a Major Hayward Earthquake." This data repo contains three directories. 1. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: hospitals; seismic risk; earthquake response; mobility. Published 2024-03-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
